question_traced: For each term, what layer or object does it modify?

evidence: workload_tiers pairs bounded_physical_edge_witnesses against full_route_empirical_anchors
proposed_public_route.bounded_physical_only_sources lists the six bounded sources
C4B commission line 33: 'exact physical-only versus full-route proof mode'
C4B commission line 38: 'bounded fresh physical-only'
C4B 00_RETURN.md line 31 and workload stop_law: 'No physical witness may create survey semantics' / 'semantic authority from a physical witness'
C4B template semantic_ceilings: NO_PHYSICAL_SUCCESS_AS_SURVEY_SEMANTICS
decoder d3d828c171ea9fdd0e90563aff6ef705f5aae2cf docstring: 'deliberately stops at physical incidence', witnesses are 'independent', 'never reconciled or promoted to survey semantics'
terms.verdict: PHYSICAL names the physical-source/witness layer and its proof-mode tier. It is explicitly the layer BELOW semantics. It does not name an I/O granularity.

terms.modifies: the READ WITNESS SCOPE — which variables the witness covers
evidence: C4B 01 freeze binds exact_governed_operations per source: variable_name + ordinal + native_codes (SRC02 Q10B@58; SRC06 Q101@20,Q2061B@19; SRC14 v372@466)
C4B commission line 105 frames the SRC08/SRC12 alternative as 'selected-column decoder validation' — a validation SCOPE, not a byte property
C4B 00_RETURN.md line 27: SRC08/SRC12 are 'decoder-admission / metadata-only witnesses'; 'No selected-column target is frozen'
C4B template allowed_operations.kind = SELECTED_VARIABLE_PHYSICAL
G01 31a9afd7d91ed4cb2fb1c1aab3ef86a5fdda1f85 takes variable_name and ordinal as APPLICABILITY IDENTIFIERS for a representation rule, not as an I/O scope
C4 accounting law PHASE 6 enumerates 'selected-column reads' as one account among ten
terms.verdict: SELECTED_VARIABLE_READ names the reader-invocation / output scope: which variable or variables the read witness is authorized to cover, pinned by exact name and ordinal.

terms.modifies: the ACTIVITY — that only a read is performed
evidence: It qualifies the ACTIVITY noun-phrase, not the byte scope.
It co-occurs with BOUNDED and FRESH, i.e. it bounds the operation class.
C4B stop_law forbids retention/pooling/comparability from a physical witness, which is what _ONLY constrained
It was dropped when C4 introduced numeric read counters, replacing a qualitative adjective with a counted budget
terms.verdict: READ_ONLY meant 'only a read is performed' — bounded, non-retaining, non-semantic. It never meant 'only these bytes are read'.

terms.modifies: a COUNT of reader invocations, budgeted per source
evidence: C4 commission PHASE 6 lists it under 'must separately account for', as a sibling of 'full reads' and 'byte counts where measurable'
No prose definition accompanies it anywhere
Alt-B 3a5b2cbc7 recorded it as a value with provenance and approved
HQ190-C be1af859a graded it E=1 with provenance 'artifact 07 .SRCxx.expected_selected_reads'
terms.verdict: A numeric per-source budget on reader invocations. Never defined in prose. Its unit is established by structural position, not by definition.

terms.modifies: a COUNT of reader invocations whose scope is the whole source
evidence: Sits as the sibling of expected_selected_reads in the same per-source object
Zero for every source in the fresh-read set; SRC27 is governed by a separate governed_full_route_passes account instead
terms.verdict: A numeric per-source budget of zero on whole-source reader invocations. See 04_FULL_READS_ZERO_MEANING.json for its exact meaning.

the_defining_C3_authorities.note: C4B binds SRC02/SRC06 to C3 G01 and SRC14 to C3 D02. These were traced directly.

g01.finding: G01 is a PURE VALUE-REPRESENTATION authority. variable_name/ordinal select which representation rule applies. It never invokes a reader and therefore cannot own, require or measure any read, physical or logical.

qualified_tests_perform_no_io.finding: Both accepted C3 qualified courts exercise pure authority/codec functions with (source, variable, ordinal, code) tuples. Neither opens, reads or projects a file. The authorities that define the selected-variable ceilings own no I/O whatsoever.

the_reference_decoder_at_freeze.variable_enumeration: names = list(metadata.column_names); every column becomes a PhysicalVariable with ordinal 1..N. No filter is applied.
the_reference_decoder_at_freeze.iter_batches_read: pyreadstat.read_file_in_chunks(reader, self._source_path, chunksize=..., encoding=..., apply_value_formats=False, user_missing=True) — no column restriction
the_reference_decoder_at_freeze.iter_batches_scope_realisation: PhysicalCell objects are emitted only for self.variables, i.e. the selected scope is realised at the CELL-EMISSION layer, downstream of a whole-file physical read
the_reference_decoder_at_freeze.docstring: This module deliberately stops at physical incidence. It never maps a raw value to a C11 response state or interprets a label. Raw header declarations, reader-normalized geometry, display metadata, and reader/config identity are preserved as independent witnesses.
the_reference_decoder_at_freeze.significance: The authority chain's own reference implementation realises variable scope at emission over a whole-file read, and contains no selected-read operation of either kind. Reading B would make the defining implementation self-violating at freeze time, which is not a coherent reconstruction of intent.
